author: Tpak
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

I have been banned of your server for 4 months and 8 days. In my opinion that is long enough. And yes, I know that it was my repsonsibility but I am no longer that dim-whitted to leave my minecraft account unaware. It is partially my fault for letting him play on Avicus, I have quotated what I had put from my last appeal: "I have been banned for hacking, I have already made an appeal; it got denied. I will explain the full story: My friend Liam came round to my house, I let him go on minecraft whilst I had to get changed, washed and brush my teeth for bed (since he was staying the night.) I didn't notice he was using hacks, but I imagined he was using 1.8 optifine. Then I was on my tablet watching YouTube with my headphones plugged in. Then he said to me "Billy, I got banned of this server." (granted, he was only 9.) I was very frustrated, and then I learnt that hacking was really unacceptable, so I deleted my hacks (The only reason I have hacks is because my friend Kyle told me to download them, so I got them, and we kept on pranking our other friend Hubert on his server, I got banned of his server, temporarily, and then I exited out of minecraft, next time it was opened, Liam was on it. So that is why he had hacks on, on Avicus.) I hope you understand that it was not all my fault and that I hope you can unban me so I can play with my friend Alf (IGN: Alfs)." That is my story, hopefully you read this appeal, in that big chunk of texts, I stated: Why I have hacks, Why I got banned and the reason I didn't notice he was using them. This is sad for me because, at the time, Avicus was one of my favourite servers, I was so irritated that I was banned of Avicus. If this appeal does get denied, I will wish that you state why (other than responsibility reasons.) This appeal was solely made so that I can have some fun with my friends. It was a one-time hack, and I didn't even hack (again, I have stated that I was Liam whom is 9 years old) I wish that you justify your decision of rejecting my appeal.

Anyways, kindest regards
-Billlz.

replies.author: Tpak
replies.body: Pagup (I am fairly certain) is my younger brother (Ben's) account (he is 11 years old.) And yes, I am aware that you do IP checks and found out that we both share the same IP, we are just living in the same household.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Alright. 

Since you have been banned for a large amount of time, and you have provided effort and an explanation to your ban, I will lift your infraction. However, please be careful with your account, and if you are banned again, your chances of appealing again will be much lower. Remember to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back.

Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator
